text:
Sara CSM: Quick heads up — Lumenix renewal is due next Wed. They want to move from 12mo to a 9mo term (customer asks for pro-rated start from May 1). PO hasn’t arrived and procurement needs vendor code. Also docusign failed because signer email didn't match. Can we triage?
Miguel AM: Ugh, timeline tight. Do we have any flexibility on start date if PO lands late?
Sara CSM: They’re asking for retroactive billing to May 1, yes. Finance said they can approve proration if vendor code and PO are on file before renewal date.
Jordan Finance: Confirmed — need vendor code + PO. If PO comes after renewal we'll need a short amendment and credit note. Net30 vs Net45 still TBD (customer prefers Net45).
Priya Legal: Who is listed as signer on their doc? If signer authority doesn't match our SOW, we need a delegated sign-off or corporate auth letter.
Sara CSM: Doc lists "VP Procurement" (emma@lumenix.com) but Docusign returned: "recipient not in account" error. Might be a corporate tenant mismatch.
docusign-bot: ERROR 403: recipient_id could not be resolved for the provided email. Suggest: resend to alternate email or use "send via email with identity verification" option.
Miguel AM: Do we have alternate contact? I have Ethan (customer lead) who mentioned finance@lumenix.corp as billing. Trying him now.
Alex Enablement: Heads-up — we paused the onboarding kickoff until contract + PO are complete. If this slips >1 week we’ll need to reschedule trainers.
Priya Legal: If they need a delegated signer, ask them to provide a signed letter on company letterhead plus ID match. That should unblock e-sign with our standard flow.
Jordan Finance: Also request vendor code from their procurement team. Example: "VN-XXXX". Without it we can’t invoice properly.
Sara CSM: Action items: Miguel to call Ethan and get alt signer + vendor code (ETA today). Miguel to ask for PO PDF to be uploaded to Zendesk ticket. Priya will draft a one-paragraph delegated-signer template I can send. Jordan to pre-approve proration once PO + vendor code present. Alex will tentatively hold May 6 kickoff window but mark tentative.
Miguel AM: On it — pinging Ethan now. I'll post the PO or vendor code here when I have it.
Sara CSM: Thanks team :pray: If we get PO before EOD we can keep renewal on schedule. If not, we’ll prepare amendment language (9mo proration + Net45) and a credit note path.
Jordan Finance: If amendment needed, please include exact proration math. Example to use in docs: ``Prorated fee = (annual fee / 12) * months charged``.
Priya Legal: Draft ready, will paste below once Miguel confirms signer name.
Miguel AM: Update — Ethan confirmed vendor code is VN-8932 and attached PO in Slack DM. Uploading to Zendesk now. Also confirmed alternate signer is emma@lumenix.com (VP Procurement). Resend Docusign to that address.
Sara CSM: Uploaded PO to ticket and updated renewal record. Re-sending Docusign now to emma@lumenix.com.
docusign-bot: SENT: Envelope ID 0a1b2c — recipient emma@lumenix.com.
Sara CSM: Great. Priya, you can send the delegated-signer template if we need it, but looks like docusign went through. Alex — hold May 6 kickoff as tentative for 24hrs.
Alex Enablement: Marked tentative. If envelope completes today we’ll keep trainers on stand-by.
Priya Legal: Template below if needed: "I, [Name], VP Procurement, confirm authority to bind Lumenix for purchase order #..." — will DM full version.
Jordan Finance: Once envelope complete, I’ll finalize proration numbers and issue invoice terms (Net45).
Sara CSM: Closing loop — thanks everyone. I'll post final status when docusign is completed or if PO changes. :white_check_mark:
